info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Credit Risk Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Credit Risk Operations Management API facilitates the creation of operational actions related to credit risk in wholesale trading. This API allows users to define and submit various operational actions necessary for effective credit risk management. Typical consumers include financial institutions, liquidity providers, and operational teams involved in risk assessment. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their risk operations, ensuring compliance and optimized decision-making in trading activities.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for credit risk.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action within the credit risk operations of wholesale trading. It handles necessary validations and returns the result of the action.
